name: plan
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk plan (region landing zone built on a network baseline).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this plan.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this plan to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: network_baseline_id
attributes.description: ID of the network baseline this plan is built on.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: primary_hosted_zone_id
attributes.description: ID of the primary Route 53 hosted zone provisioned by the plan.

attributes.name: primary_hosted_zone_domain
attributes.description: Domain name of the primary hosted zone.

attributes.name: certificate_arns
attributes.description: ARNs of certificates provisioned by the plan.

attributes.name: ami_ids
attributes.description: IDs of AMIs registered by the plan.

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
